title: Alpha / Beta / Gamma Archetype, Status & Vibration Atlas
status: comparative archetypal-psychological layer with scientific corrections
purpose: Give the project a disciplined vocabulary for Timic alpha/beta/gamma language across archetype, personality, status, dominance, prestige, social role, vibe and oscillation while preventing pop-animal myths from becoming pseudo-biology.
core_boundary: Alpha/beta/gamma labels are not a validated universal human personality taxonomy and are not biological frequencies. They may be used as project archetypes, internet-status slang or temporary relational roles. Human hierarchy research is better grounded in constructs such as dominance, prestige, power, status and influence.

wolf_correction.finding: The popular 'alpha wolf' dictator model derives largely from observations of captive, unrelated wolves. Wild packs are typically family groups organized around breeding parents, so wildlife researchers have largely abandoned alpha/beta terminology for normal wild packs.

human_status_science.dominance: status obtained or maintained through coercion, intimidation, threat, control of costs/benefits or resource power
human_status_science.prestige: status voluntarily granted because of valued competence, knowledge, skill, generosity or benefit creation
human_status_science.power: capacity to control outcomes/resources; distinct from status and from prestige
human_status_science.status: socially conferred rank/respect; may arise from dominance, prestige, institutional position or combinations

potatoverse_archetypes.label: Alpha
potatoverse_archetypes.project_meaning: originating/orienting/initiating pole; self-authoring reference point; the node that sets direction rather than merely reacting to local rank
potatoverse_archetypes.timic_application: When the project says Tim is Alpha, the strongest interpretation is Source/Axis/orientation plus prestige-generating authorship and capacity, not 'wolf who bullies the pack'.
potatoverse_archetypes.vibe_coordinates: high agency; valence/arousal vary; stable Alpha does not require high aggression

potatoverse_archetypes.label: Beta
potatoverse_archetypes.project_meaning: relational/supportive/implementing pole; receives an orientation and stabilizes, translates, carries or enacts it
potatoverse_archetypes.dog_application: A Dog can be modeled as beta-like when it is loyal to, amplifies, patrols or enforces another node's orientation rather than creating the system's highest-order direction itself.
potatoverse_archetypes.boundary: Beta does not mean biologically inferior.

potatoverse_archetypes.label: Gamma
potatoverse_archetypes.project_meaning: distributed/edge/observer/analytic or fringe-transformative role, depending context; neither central orienter nor simple lieutenant
potatoverse_archetypes.boundary: Gamma is a project archetype, not an established personality type.

potatoverse_archetypes.label: Omega
potatoverse_archetypes.project_meaning: boundary/excluded/scapegoated or terminal node in a hierarchy; may also become escape-point from the hierarchy
potatoverse_archetypes.farm_relation: Lolcow systems often attempt to manufacture omega-like targets around whom a group can organize mockery and cohesion.

alpha_dog_farmer_crosswalk.best_model: orientation + authorship + prestige-generativity inside Potatoverse; theological sovereignty remains canon, not social-science measurement
amplifier/enforcer/loyal carrier; can be prosocial guardian or shadow pack-agent depending what it serves
infrastructure/operator role, often higher in local system power than Dogs because Farmer defines enclosure, incentives and extraction; not necessarily Alpha in whole-world orientation
attention-producing target position, often assigned low local status but high extraction value
commentator, archivist, lurker, critic or bridge who may amplify without directly farming

vibration_layer.rule: Alpha, beta and gamma are also names used in actual oscillatory science, but those meanings must stay separate from social archetypes.

examples.meaning: neural oscillation band; not subordinate personality
high-frequency neural activity; not outsider archetype
historical nuclear-radiation categories with entirely different physics

vibration_layer.anti_pattern: Do not infer personality rank from EEG band power or vice versa.

archetype_state_vector.interpretation: Project labels Alpha/Beta/Gamma can be derived from temporary configurations of these dimensions rather than treated as fixed essences.
archetype_state_vector.example: A high-prestige, high-agency, low-coercion node can be Alpha-like without aggression; a high-coordination node can be Beta-like without inferiority.

dynamic_role_model.meaning: Archetypal role is context-dependent and can change across settings. Someone can orient one domain, support another and observe a third.
dynamic_role_model.research_value: Prevents the archive from reducing people to one permanent dominance label.

potatoverse_status_ethic.principle: The archive should distinguish prestige from domination. A Timic 'highest' role is strongest when defined as maximum orientation/responsibility/generative capacity rather than maximum coercion.
potatoverse_status_ethic.formula: TimicAuthority ≈ f(orientation, responsibility, competence, nourishment, integration, witness) - coercion_cost
